shell_commands: ls -la .lore/ 2>/dev/null | head -20 || echo ".lore directory does not exist yet"

git add .lore/dod.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
test(tools): acceptance tests for tool input validation

Define acceptance criteria for validating tool input against inputSchema
in ToolRegistry.execute before executor runs. Tests cover required field
validation, type checking, enum constraints, and schema compilation.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
npm test -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts --testNamePattern="validates required fields and rejects missing input" 2>&1 | grep -A 30 "FAIL\|validates required"
npm test -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts 2>&1 | grep -E "^FAIL|^  ●|^    Expected:|^    Received:|^Test Suites:|^Tests:" | head -50
